lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: If you're here for photos, the crew packed up ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: No photos. I saw the deck box next to your bag.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Then you have better eyes than half the people on that set. It's mine.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What do you play?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Blackout. I like making my opponent work for every card they keep.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I've got a few minutes before my ride. Show me your list and I'll show you mine.

choices.label: Ask which cards make Blackout work
choices.reply: Energy denial. Hand disruption. Nothing glamorous until the other player can't do anything useful.

choices.label: Tell her the deck box caught your eye before the camera did
choices.reply: Ha. The deck box is chipped and covered in tape, so that's a first.

choices.label: Admit the shoot looked great, then ask for a match
choices.reply: Thank you. Now let's find out whether you're as good at shuffling as you are at talking.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Forty minutes before my next booking. I brought a stopwatch.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You actually timed us?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I told my agent I'd be ready when the car came. I meant it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: All right. What are we testing?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: My opening turns. I keep burning my hand too early, then pretending it was bad luck.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Deal five. I'll tell you when you're making excuses.

choices.label: Run opening hands and challenge her sequencing
choices.reply: Good. If I misplay, call it. Don't rescue me with a compliment.

choices.label: Ask why she keeps the bookings so tightly scheduled
choices.reply: I like the work. I just want to keep some hours for things that are mine.

choices.label: Tease her about needing a stopwatch for a friendly match
choices.reply: A friendly match? You brought the scary deck. I had to protect my afternoon.

openingByFlag.sierra_deck: You asked about my deck last time. Still want to hear the ugly details?
openingByFlag.sierra_notice: You noticed the deck box first. That’s still weird. In a good way.
openingByFlag.sierra_honest: You were honest about the bikini and the cards. Most people only manage one.

events.title: The Only Place That Feels Real

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I lost to a kid who kept the same Basic in play for half the match.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Ouch. What happened?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I spent three turns waiting for a perfect hand and forgot to put pressure on the board.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: So you're changing the list?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Maybe. First I'm changing how I play it. Will you run the same opening against me?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: And no going easy because I'm sulking. I'm already doing enough of that for both of us.

choices.label: Run the matchup until she finds a better line
choices.reply: There. That's the turn. I kept overthinking a move I already had.

choices.label: Tell her one bad game doesn't invalidate the deck
choices.reply: I know. I'm annoyed at myself, not the cards. Give me five minutes.

choices.label: Offer a friendly wager on the next practice match
choices.reply: If I win, you buy the snacks. If you win... you also buy the snacks. Kidding.

openingByFlag.sierra_matchup: You actually talked matchups with me. So I showed up ready.
openingByFlag.sierra_version: You said you liked the version that talks about cards. Here she is.
openingByFlag.sierra_lightup: You noticed I light up. Annoying. Accurate. Let’s play.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I told my agent I can't take Sunday calls anymore. That's my practice block.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Did she take it well?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: She said I was making her job harder. I told her I'm still showing up Monday.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: So you didn't quit the campaign?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Why would I? I like the work. I also like this. I'm done letting the calendar choose for me.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I reserved this table for an hour. Want to help me see if the new list holds up?

choices.label: Accept the practice session and respect her schedule
choices.reply: Perfect. Then let's spend the first ten minutes fixing the Energy curve.

choices.label: Ask what else she'd like to make time for
choices.reply: A whole afternoon with nothing booked, eventually. I might not even bring my phone.

choices.label: Say you'll be glad to see her on and off the tournament table
choices.reply: Careful. I could get used to someone who doesn't make it an either-or question.

openingByFlag.sierra_serious: You played me for real. So I’m showing up for real.
openingByFlag.sierra_noperform: You said I don’t have to perform. I’m testing that.
openingByFlag.sierra_both: You said you liked both versions. Today you get the unstyled one.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: My agent came to watch a practice game. She said I looked more alive losing here than smiling through the last photo shoot.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Big match?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Big enough for me. I showed her the opening I keep misplaying; she offered to hold the stopwatch.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Nervous. Excited. A little furious at that same opening hand I keep drawing.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: After the cup, whether you win or lose, would you come get dinner with me? No cameras, but cards are allowed.

choices.label: Accept dinner as friends and promise an honest rematch
choices.reply: Deal. But I'm still going over your deck list during dessert. Fair warning.

choices.label: Ask her to make the next dinner a proper date
choices.reply: I thought you'd never ask. No camera crew, no schedule. Just us. And actual food.

choices.label: Tell her you'd like more time together, without fixing a label yet
choices.reply: Then keep next Saturday free. We'll figure out the rest after dinner.

openingByFlag.sierra_usedto: You told me to get used to being treated like a person. I’m trying.
openingByFlag.sierra_future: You asked what I wanted beyond the next tournament. I’m still answering that.
openingByFlag.sierra_real: You said you liked the real me more than the photos. I’m holding you to it.
